title: feat(search): add user filters to search_issues
body:
`search_issues` can now filter by `assigned`, `created`, `mentioned`, `review_requested` and `reviewed`, which the issue search API and the Go SDK already support. This lets a client list, for example, the pull requests awaiting the user's review in one call, instead of listing every repository, its pull requests and their reviews.

`query` may be omitted when one of these filters is set. Without either, the call is still rejected as before.

Against a Gitea instance with about 150 repositories, the review queue took 1 call and 0.18 s, versus 26 calls, 135 KB and about 12 s with the existing tools.

### HTTP/1 server crash due to MaxBytesReader header race in net/http
[CVE-2026-97054](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-97054) / [GO-2026-6859](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6859)

<details>
<summary>More information</summary>

#### Details
For HTTP/1 servers, when MaxBytesReader's limit is exceeded, "Connection: close" header is automatically set without synchronization, which might race with another header being set explicitly in the server handler. As a result, an HTTP/1 server that utilizes MaxBytesReader or MaxBytesHandler can crash due to runtime panic if its handler reads the request body concurrently with writing the response header.

#### Severity
Unknown

#### References
- [https://go.dev/cl/862185](https://go.dev/cl/862185)
- [https://go.dev/issue/82563](https://go.dev/issue/82563)

</details>

title: WIP: enhance: add host.stable_workdir for predictable host job paths
body:
Adds an opt-in `host.stable_workdir` that runs host jobs in `<host.workdir_parent>/workspaces/<owner>/<repo>/<slot>/hostexecutor` instead of a random directory, so they are easy to find and set permissions on. Only the path is stable: contents are still removed after each job, and the path is fully stable only at capacity 1.

Depends on https://gitea.com/orbit/orbit/pulls/1401 for the slot allocator, please merge that first. Until then this PR also shows its commit.

Fixes: https://gitea.com/orbit/orbit/issues/1373

title: WIP: feat: point ubuntu-latest to ubuntu 26.04
body:
Moves the `ubuntu-latest` and `ubuntu-latest-full` tags to 26.04, following GitHub moving its `ubuntu-latest` label by November 19. Unlike GitHub's x64-only announcement, this also moves arm64, since the tags are multi-arch.

Fixes: https://gitea.com/orbit/orbit/issues/1334

title: enhance: run JavaScript actions from a host Node with container.node_dir
body:
Docker jobs fail on images without node, while GitHub supplies its own. `container.node_dir` mounts a Node install from the Docker daemon's host read-only at `/__e/node` for JavaScript actions and `hashFiles`. It stays off `PATH`, so steps and `actions/setup-node` see only what the job installs. The build must match the job images' architecture and libc.

Fixes: https://gitea.com/orbit/orbit/issues/1393
Fixes: https://gitea.com/orbit/orbit/issues/538
